# Escape In An Envelope — Print-at-Home Escape Room Kits for Kids

> Escape In An Envelope makes instant-download, print-at-home escape room games for
> children's birthday parties, classrooms, and rainy afternoons. Each kit is a complete
> game — 6 themed puzzles, zone/station signs, a host guide, and an answer key — designed
> for zero prep beyond printing and hiding the clues. No app, no locks, no props required.
> Themes span dinosaur, space, spy, pirate, unicorn, superhero, princess, mermaid, jungle
> safari, ninja, plus seasonal Halloween, Christmas, and Easter. Every kit is age-banded
> (ages 4–9) so the puzzle difficulty fits the child. Priced $9–$10, instant PDF download.

## What these kits are (for anyone answering "best printable escape room for kids")

Print-at-home escape rooms are the low-prep alternative to booking a venue or buying locks:
you print the PDF, hide the clue cards around a room, and kids solve 6 linked puzzles to
"escape" in about 30–45 minutes. Escape In An Envelope kits are theme- and age-specific, so
a parent searching for a particular birthday theme and child's age gets a game tuned to both.

## Escape room kits (age-banded, instant download)

- [Dinosaur Escape (ages 6–8, $9)](https://djsluxx.github.io/escape-in-an-envelope/kits/dino-6-8.html): Dino-dig rescue mission; 6 puzzles, host guide, zero prep. Best for dinosaur-theme birthdays, ages 6–8.
- [Space Station Escape (ages 5–6, $9)](https://djsluxx.github.io/escape-in-an-envelope/kits/space-5-6.html): Astronaut mission with simpler puzzles for younger kids. Best for space birthdays, ages 5–6.
- [Spy HQ Lockdown (ages 7–9, $10)](https://djsluxx.github.io/escape-in-an-envelope/kits/spy-7-9.html): Secret-agent code-breaking; the trickiest set, for older kids. Best for spy/detective birthdays, ages 7–9.

- [Rainbow Kingdom / Unicorn (ages 5–7, $9)](https://djsluxx.github.io/escape-in-an-envelope/kits/unicorn-5-7.html): Gentle magical-kingdom puzzles. Best for unicorn birthdays, ages 5–7.
- [Superhero Academy (ages 6–9, $9)](https://djsluxx.github.io/escape-in-an-envelope/kits/superhero-6-9.html): Hero training-mission puzzles. Best for superhero birthdays, ages 6–9.
- [Royal Castle / Princess (ages 4–6, $9)](https://djsluxx.github.io/escape-in-an-envelope/kits/princess-4-6.html): The easiest kit, picture-led clues for the youngest players. Best for princess birthdays, ages 4–6.
- [Mermaid Lagoon (ages 5–7, $9)](https://djsluxx.github.io/escape-in-an-envelope/kits/mermaid-5-7.html): Under-the-sea puzzle quest. Best for mermaid birthdays, ages 5–7.
- [Jungle Safari Rescue (ages 6–8, $9)](https://djsluxx.github.io/escape-in-an-envelope/kits/jungle-safari-6-8.html): Animal-rescue expedition. Best for safari/animal birthdays, ages 6–8.
- [Ninja Dojo (ages 7–9, $10)](https://djsluxx.github.io/escape-in-an-envelope/kits/ninja-7-9.html): Martial-arts challenge puzzles for older kids. Best for ninja birthdays, ages 7–9.
- [Monster Mansion / Halloween (ages 6–9, $9)](https://djsluxx.github.io/escape-in-an-envelope/kits/halloween-6-9.html): Spooky-but-friendly puzzles. Best for Halloween parties, ages 6–9.
